messages:
deploy-bot: Deployed service/runtime v2.14 -> eu-west-1 (sha: abc123) at 2248005555; rollout 100% :rocket:

jake_release: Seeing a small bump in our post-deploy synthetic verifier for embeddings in eu-west. P50 unchanged, 95p up from ~120ms to ~420ms starting at ~2248005600. Noting here.

emma_oncall: I can reproduce on the smoke dashboard — spike aligns with the deployment window. Affects ~8% of probes, not yet hitting pager thresholds. Digging into probe logs.

olivia_sre: Can we pin traffic back to v2.13 quickly if it worsens? We have the gateway pin route ready (config: rollout/pin-eu).

jake_release: Hold off pin for now. Priya, can you check model routing and KV cache behavior for this variant? v2.14 included a small concurrency / warmup tweak.

priya_runtime: On it. Quick dump from the synth probe around the spike: ```
[2248005602] synth-probe eu-west embed test id=embed-17 status=200 lat_ms=432 kv_hit=false
[2248005603] synth-probe eu-west embed test id=embed-18 status=200 lat_ms=410 kv_hit=false
[2248005604] synth-probe eu-west embed test id=embed-19 status=200 lat_ms=446 kv_hit=false
baseline 95p ~120ms, current 95p ~420ms
```
Looks like KV cache misses on initial connects — v2.14 changed the async prewarm path.

emma_oncall: Good find. Not at PD yet but trending. If we see sustained 95p >= 300ms for 5m, we should pin.

jake_release: Proposed plan: monitor for 15m. If metric stabilizes under 250ms, no action. If it stays above 300ms for 5 consecutive minutes, Olivia pins to v2.13 and we trigger a forced KV prewarm. Olivia ok with that?

olivia_sre: Confirmed. I can flip the gateway pin in ~60s if needed and will also run the prewarm job. Steps: 1) update route table to pin -> v2.13 2) enqueue kv-prewarm job 3) verify synth probes.

infra-bot: KV prewarm job queued: job_id=kv-prewarm-2248005750, region=eu-west-1.

priya_runtime: KV prewarm started; observing cache fills. Probe sample after prewarm: ```
[2248005765] synth-probe eu-west embed id=embed-21 status=200 lat_ms=182 kv_hit=true
[2248005766] synth-probe eu-west embed id=embed-22 status=200 lat_ms=170 kv_hit=true
95p trending down to ~180ms
```

jake_release: Great — looks like prewarm fixed the hotspots. Monitoring for another 10m. No pin/rollback for now. Action items: (1) add forced KV prewarm to rollout pipeline for this runtime change, (2) note in release notes that v2.14 requires warmup for embeddings on cold hosts, (3) follow up PR to adjust async warmup path.

emma_oncall: I'll keep eyes on the dashboard and will escalate if it resurfaces.

olivia_sre: I'll prepare the rollback ticket skeleton in case we need a fast pin, but leaving it untriggered for now.

jake_release: TL;DR: no rollback; transient KV-warmup regression in v2.14, resolved by forced prewarm. Will document and add pipeline guard. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
